label: Demo set: Earth Engine runs of 13 Oct 2026 (commit df45350), stands re-merged under `spec-merge-pass2-skip-at-minimum`. Upstream of the merge it carries the open cache-grid issue (PR #42, question 1). The final re-run replaces it.
what: The 14 from-scratch re-runs of 13 Oct 2026 (PR #42), one per configs/*_repro.yaml. Tools read the saved assets by the paths given here, never by recomputing a fingerprint.
assets_listed: ee.data.listAssets on each run's asset folder, read-only
open_issue: Cached features sit on a geographic grid and segmentation works on the UTM grid, so a run's superpixels depend on whether its features were cached when it segmented (docs/reproducibility.md, 'Superpixels depend on whether the features were cached when SNIC ran'; PR #42, question 1). The route each run took is in segmentation_route.
